title: Vietnam veteran on shooting at spooks

tellings.quote: You think you shoot at somebody, you ain't shoot at nothing. Waste your fire out there. Guy in Vietnam told me that.

plain: A soldier in Vietnam once warned that firing at the strange things out there was pointless: you think you are shooting at somebody, but you hit nothing and just waste your ammunition. Michael Johnson, a guest on an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were taken by aliens, repeats it as something "a guy in Vietnam told me." The point is that soldiers may have faced things bullets could not touch.
